name: xlsft`s harness client
description: Installs harness-client from a release (or an update mirror) and points it at your xlsft`s harness server. docs/devcontainers.md is the guide.

version.description: A release version such as 0.2.0, or latest.

serverUrl.description: Your server. Written to the container's machine policy (/etc/harness/settings.d/00-server.json), so `harness-client login` needs no URL.

mirror.description: An update mirror (scripts/release/offline-bundle.sh) to install from instead of GitHub. Also written as updateMirrorUrl.

disableUpdates.description: Turn off `harness-client update` inside the container: the image is rebuilt to update it.
